packet.title: Fast Invisible XML (book, tests, implementation)
packet.summary: Makes Invisible XML fast: a book part and benchmark suite first, then lookahead sets, Leo items, codepoint classes and grammar simplification, so right recursion is linear.

body.p: After (7.18: the Earley parser, right recursion quadratic, every item a step). The owner: high performance; book first, then conformance and benchmarks, then the implementation.

item.p: Owns: docs/book/src/ixml*.md, docs/book/examples/ixml/, tests/bench/run-ixml-bench.py, tests/bench/ixml/, src/ixml.c, src/ixml_earley.c, src/ixml_tables.c, src/ixml_internal.h, src/function_library_ixml.c, tests/ixml_test.c.

Done when: the book's performance chapter passes (run-ixml-bench.py --check and its examples); no iXML suite or QT4 iXML case lost; , allocator memory, honest steps. Done 2026-10-20 (): the part "Parsing Text with Invisible XML"; the benchmark suite; lookahead sets, Leo items, codepoint classes, grammar simplification. 1 MB in 0.18 to 0.53 s (was 1.1 to 3.2 s), right recursion linear; suite 886/907 and QT4 unchanged.
